messages:
maria: Heads up — EU1 NAT egress is near saturation, we're seeing 5xx spikes and queued tokens on gpu-pool-2. Throttling policy may be needed now. (observed 98% NAT conn usage)

jamal: Confirming, GPU queue depth up 3x last 10m. Some customers hitting 429s. Logs: `redispatcher: client=acme-gen timeout=120s`

ops- bot: Incident created: INC-2026-513 EU1 egress pressure (priority=P1)

maria: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Apply per-customer soft cap (50qps) on non-enterprise customers 2) QoS rewrite at LB to deprioritize low-tier traffic 3) Shift 30% of non-sensitive traffic to eu-north1. Thoughts?

sre-jen: +1 on caps. How fast can we push the LB QoS? We have a prewritten rate-limit config in /infra/rate-limits/eu1-emer.json

alex: I can push the QoS via envoy patch: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-qos --patch "$(cat eu1-emer.json)"` — will do canary to two nodes first. ETA 3m.

jamal: Also recommend enabling `auto-fallback` to smaller quantized models for opportunistic inference to reduce GPU memory pressure. Can ML team approve?

eng-ml-kai: We can enable a temporary model profile mapping (gpt-small -> gpt-quant2) for non-high-sla routes. Doing rollout with `redwood-tool rollout model-profile --region eu1 --profile temp-qlower` — ready.

maria: Sales/CS: @sales-anna @support-lee please prepare templated message for affected customers (non-enterprise) that we are rate-limiting transiently due to network egress pressure.

sales-anna: On it. Suggest offering priority pass for enterprise customers and credits for impacted usage. Draft in #customer-ops.

ops- bot: Deploy started: envoy-patch canary on node eu1-lb-3

alex: Canary success on node 3, no regressions. Applying to remaining LBs now.

maria: Applied soft caps to non-enterprise: `quota: per_customer_requests_per_minute: 300` — monitoring.

jamal: QPS dropped 40%, queue depth returning to normal. GPU utilization down ~15%.

maria: Keeping incident open until NAT conn usage < 80% for 30m. Next: followup runbook for provisioning more NAT capacity and evaluate longer-term egress peering with cloud provider.

sre-jen: Creating followup ticket: TASK-6573 egress-scaling + peering eval.

support-lee: Customer thread created for acme-gen, flagged as priority.

maria: Thanks all, will update after 30m. :white_check_mark:
